siteContent.cmsAboutSustainDesc:
Fabric-8 is
            committed to responsible sourcing and operational integrity. We work with manufacturers who maintain
            compliance with applicable labor standards, occupational health and safety requirements, and environmental
            regulations. Our quality control process includes pre-shipment inspection and documentation review to ensure
            every delivery meets agreed specifications. We are committed to continuous improvement in our environmental
            footprint and encourage clients to consider sustainable fabric options where applicable.

siteContent.cmsMethodSub: The operational backbone behind every Fabric8 uniform engagement.
siteContent.methodSub: The operational backbone behind every Fabric8 uniform engagement.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep1Desc: Needs, pain points, brand identity, and operational environment are mapped first.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep1BackDesc: We begin by listening: Your needs, pain-points, brand identity requirements, and operational environment are mapped before any solution is proposed.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep2Desc: Garment and textile solutions are tailored to role profile, climate, and budget...
siteContent.cmsMethodStep2BackDesc: We advise on garment and textile solutions tailored to your role profile, climate, and budget. There is always the right fabric for the right job.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep3Desc: Quantity, item selection, and distribution are optimized for maximum value.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep3BackDesc: We optimize quantity, item selection, and distribution to get maximum value within your approved budget and no surprises.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep4Desc: Alterations, edits, and specifications are locked before production.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep4BackDesc: During the PO stage we manage alterations, edits, and problem-solving so your specification is locked and correct before production begins.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep5Desc: Embroidery, printing, and finishing transform garments into brand assets.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep5BackDesc: Embroidery, printing, and finishing transform each garment into a brand asset: consistent, professional, and identity-aligned.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep6Desc: Production follows agreed specifications with quality control checkpoints.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep6BackDesc: Production is executed by agreed specifications, with quality control checkpoints and compliance with applicable health and safety standards throughout.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep7Desc: Freight and final-mile delivery are coordinated and tracked to required orders.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep7BackDesc: Coordinated freight and final-mile delivery to your sites, tracked and confirmed using critical path method for required orders.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep8Desc: Guidance, reorders, support, and lifecycle planning continue after delivery.
siteContent.cmsMethodStep8BackDesc: Our relationship does not end at delivery. We handle guidance, problem solving, re-orders, and ongoing support for the lifecycle of your uniform planning.
